notes.title: (Bug Fixes) 1.1.1
notes.notes:
Bug fixes for the new update:

[olist]
 Game trying to get gamepad input instead of keyboard and mouse for some players
 Not being able to go past wave 126 in endless mode
 Not beign able to upgrade an unit past level 50
[/olist]
There are more things that i will improve next, like balancing endless mode better, and also smaller bug fixes, but i prefered to release this update fixing more serious bugs first.

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: QoL update (Bug fixes + balancing) 1.0.6
notes.notes:
Version 1.0.6

QoL Features

 The player's settings are now saved when they exit the game


Balancing

 Minor enemie HP increase
 Enemie spawns during elite rounds are no longer infinite
 Debuff on OP units (Fragmentation, Chain damage, Quick attack)


Bug fixes

 Fixed a bug that made the centipede don't shoot sometimes
 Fixed a bug that allowed skipping enemie spawns during the elite round
 Fixed a bug that made the selling hint text incorrect sometimes


What's next?

Except more QoL updates, here are some things that i have planned for the next updates:


 An inbetween run currency to buy skins and make it possible to start the run with a different unit that's not the Scout
 More units that show up only in later stages and NG+
 An Endless mode


Thanks for playing! <3
